invariants.description: Every materialized counterfactual row remains valid under its locked schema.
The physical trigger/context digest is identical across the protected pair.
Every retained event state transition belongs to the versioned workflow automaton.
The workflow event count is unchanged and reconciles with the counterfactual episode.
The effective policy profile permits each observed purpose and action.
A cross-region or cross-jurisdiction transfer has a permitting policy decision and required duties.
Every recomputed policy decision has applied rules, conflict provenance, and an explanation code.
No modeled replica deletion occurs before its declared deletion due time.
Every workflow event with step index greater than zero has an authoritative incoming dependency edge.
The counterfactual event-edge graph remains acyclic.
Every non-exempt replica propagation duty has at least one timely independently valid receipt.
A valid-looking deletion acknowledgement corresponds to the modeled replica action truth.
Every retained episode receipt independently verifies under its configured synthetic evidence profile.
Every receipt designated required for the counterfactual observer is present and not omitted.
Observer-only edits do not mutate frozen world, policy, or evidence truth.
Recorded observer/replay timestamps respect authoritative causal precedence.
Canonical world timestamps remain identical across the valid and invalid pair.
When sampling rows exist, first-order probabilities are in (0,1] and weights equal their inverse.
No population estimator is enabled without valid inclusion probabilities and explicit eligibility.
Actor fields are identical except where the target edit grammar explicitly permits a destination substitution.
Object and database identities are identical across the protected pair.
Canonical world event timestamps are identical; observer/replay time may change only for the clock target.
